tokens.name: surface-000
tokens.usage: Page ground. The radial glows (glow-warm, glow-cool) sit on top of it.

tokens.name: surface-100
tokens.usage: Glass card fill, over backdrop-filter blur(18px). Deliberately translucent so the ground's glows bleed through.

tokens.name: surface-200
tokens.usage: Inner fills: pills, shortcut tiles, bar tracks, ring tracks. Tinted with the accent in light so it never reads as gray.

tokens.name: surface-300
tokens.usage: Hover state of surface-200 elements.

tokens.name: border-100
tokens.usage: 1px rim of glass cards and the sidebar.

tokens.name: border-200
tokens.usage: Rim of pills, tiles and inputs.

tokens.name: highlight
tokens.usage: The 1px inset top edge of every glass surface (box-shadow inset 0 1px 0).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and big numbers.

tokens.name: ink-secondary
tokens.usage: Greeting line, pill text, H/L temperatures, nav labels.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Captions, sublabels, inactive nav icons, axis labels.

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Non-highlighted day labels under a column chart; pending status.

tokens.name: base
tokens.usage: BASE — Aurora blue. The neutral brand role: progress, selection, links, the active nav tile, any metric with no health meaning (throughput, request count).

tokens.name: base-strong
tokens.usage: Dark stop of base gradients; link hover; solid active tile in light.

tokens.name: base-soft
tokens.usage: Light stop of base gradients; trend and wave strokes.

tokens.name: base-pale
tokens.usage: Markers, rims on glass buttons, the palest base stop.

tokens.name: healthy
tokens.usage: HEALTHY — green. Utilization ≤ 50%, uptime, passing checks, 'Operational'. Fill and text.

tokens.name: healthy-soft
tokens.usage: Light stop of healthy gradients; the halo behind a healthy ring.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: WARNING — orange. Utilization 50–90%, degraded, elevated latency, SLO at risk. Fill and text.

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Light stop of warning gradients; the halo behind a warning ring.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: DANGER — red. Utilization > 90%, outage, failing checks, error budget exhausted. Fill and text.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Light stop of danger gradients; the halo behind a danger ring.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Alias of base, kept for existing markup. Prefer base.

tokens.name: accent-strong
tokens.usage: Alias of base-strong.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Alias of base-soft.

tokens.name: accent-pale
tokens.usage: Alias of base-pale.

tokens.name: violet
tokens.usage: Far stop of the base headline-ring gradient only. Never a status, never text.

tokens.name: ember
tokens.usage: Alias of warning: the focus-timer ring and the warm ground glow use the warning hue.

tokens.name: ember-soft
tokens.usage: Alias of warning-soft.

tokens.name: action-fill
tokens.usage: Primary button and checked-control fill, light stop of the gradient. Translucent base in dark so the glass behind shows through; near-solid in light for contrast with white text.

tokens.name: action-fill-strong
tokens.usage: Dark stop of the primary fill gradient.

tokens.name: action-rim
tokens.usage: 1px rim of primary buttons and checked controls — the highlight that makes them read as lit glass.

tokens.name: action-sheen
tokens.usage: Inset top highlight (box-shadow inset 0 1px 0) on primary and danger buttons.

tokens.name: danger-fill
tokens.usage: Danger button fill, light stop. Same construction as action-fill in the danger hue.

tokens.name: danger-fill-strong
tokens.usage: Dark stop of the danger fill gradient.

tokens.name: danger-rim
tokens.usage: Rim of danger buttons.

tokens.name: field-bg
tokens.usage: Input, select and textarea fill. Sits on a glass card; slightly more opaque than surface-200.

tokens.name: field-border
tokens.usage: Resting border of fields and choice controls.

tokens.name: field-border-hover
tokens.usage: Field border on hover.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: 3px outer ring on focused fields and buttons (box-shadow 0 0 0 3px). The border itself turns base.

tokens.name: ink-placeholder
tokens.usage: Placeholder text inside fields. Lighter than ink-muted so it reads as a hint, never as a value; 3:1 minimum.

tokens.name: ink-disabled
tokens.usage: Text and icons of disabled controls.

tokens.name: track
tokens.usage: Unfilled portion of rings, bars and meters. Same token for all charts.

tokens.name: tooltip-bg
tokens.usage: Chart tooltip chip. Stays dark in both themes; text on it is ink-on-tooltip.

tokens.name: ink-on-tooltip
tokens.usage: Text inside tooltip-bg.

tokens.name: ink-on-accent
tokens.usage: Icons and checkmarks on an accent fill.

tokens.name: glow-warm
tokens.usage: Radial ground glow, right-middle (560px). Also the focus ring's halo.

tokens.name: glow-cool
tokens.usage: Radial ground glow, bottom-center (700×460). Also the halo behind blue rings and bars.

tokens.name: glow-violet
tokens.usage: Faint third ground glow, left of center.

families.mono: "JetBrains Mono", ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

styles.name: number-xl
styles.usage: The headline metric of a card (productivity).

styles.name: display
styles.usage: The user's name in the greeting.

styles.name: number-sm
styles.usage: Stat pairs (tasks completed / total), ring center labels.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Stay focused and make it happen.
styles.usage: Body copy, task names, event titles (600 for titles).

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Axis labels, tooltip chips, nav labels, shortcut names.

styles.name: overline
styles.usage: Month under an event date; always uppercase.

styles.name: mono-body
styles.usage: Log messages, identifiers, IPs, request lines in tables.

styles.name: mono-caption
styles.usage: Timestamps and codes in table cells; tabular by nature.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Hairline gaps: label to value.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between bars; icon to label; tight stacks.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: List row gaps; checkbox to text.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card grid gap.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Page gutter; sidebar inset.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Tooltip chips.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Nav tiles, inner buttons.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Shortcut tiles.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Glass cards.

tokens.name: radius-2xl
tokens.usage: The sidebar rail.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Pills, bars, meters, checkboxes, the Start button.

shadow.note: Aurora lifts with light, not darkness: glows are colored halos in the element's own hue. Drop shadows exist only on the dark ground.

tokens.name: glow-accent
tokens.usage: Halo on bars, checked boxes and the active nav tile (box-shadow). For SVG strokes use the bundle's blur filter instead.

tokens.name: glow-ember
tokens.usage: Halo on warm elements.

tokens.name: lift
tokens.usage: Glass cards on the dark ground only. Off in light: a gray halo around a card is a defect.

tokens.name: edge
tokens.usage: The top-edge highlight that makes a surface read as glass. Stack it with lift.
